summary: We are seeking a Systems Engineer - IT Service Management with strong knowledge of IT hardware and software inventory management. The ideal candidate will have experience in asset lifecycle management, ITIL framework, and vendor coordination. This role requires excellent communication and organizational skills.
responsibilities: Strong knowledge of IT hardware and software inventory management
Experience in asset lifecycle management (procurement, deployment, maintenance, disposal)
Hands-on experience with asset tracking systems and databases
Ability to manage inward/outward movement of assets and store organization
Knowledge of e-waste handling and compliance (including approvals and secure disposal)
Familiarity with ITIL framework and audit processes
Experience in vendor coordination for repairs, AMC updates, and parts delivery
Coordination with finance team for high-value assets and approvals
Proficiency in report generation (asset status, utilization, trends)
required_skills: Strong knowledge of IT hardware and software inventory management
Hands-on experience with asset tracking systems and databases
Knowledge of e-waste handling and compliance
Familiarity with ITIL framework and audit processes
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure)
